name: Aerosurge
description:
About This Game

Aerosurge is a fast-paced arcade flying game that puts you in control of an agile jet built for high-speed action. With ultra-responsive and fluid flight controls, every turn, boost, and drift feels smooth, precise, and incredibly satisfying.

Features

  • Perform flips, barrel-rolls and drifts with responsive, physics-based flight controls that feel intuitive and precise

  • Take on intense missions that put your flying skills to the test and reward you for taking risks

  • Unlock upgrades to take on increasingly harder enemies

  • Explore diverse planets that present unique challenges and hazards
short_desc: Perform daring aerial stunts, destroy your enemies and weave through hazardous environments to complete your missions before the time runs out! Upgrade your weapons and abilities between objectives, before taking out enemies across a variety of landscapes and planets
